task.name: Serve_wine
task.when: For every guest requesting wine during a bar shift

step.action: Inspect the guest's valid government-issued photo ID.
step.ifThen: IF the ID does not show that the guest is at least 21, or the guest has no valid ID, THEN do not serve alcohol.

step.action: Tell the guest the Wine of the Day and its music and cheese pairing.
Ask the guest to hold out their cup.
Select an open half-can when one is available; otherwise open a new can.
Pour one-half can into the guest's cup.
Return any remaining half-can upright to 🍷 Wine_Cooler.
Put each crushed empty can in 🍷 Aluminum_Can_Collection.

passWhen.criterion: Every person served showed a valid ID proving an age of at least 21.
Wine was poured into guest cups; no wine can was handed to a guest.
Every empty can was crushed and put in aluminum-can collection.

reasoning.entry: Checking every guest's ID removes the workbook's subjective under-40 judgment and directly verifies the legal minimum age.
Current 2026 Burning Man guidance sends empty crushed aluminum cans to Recycle Camp, so the canonical task does not follow the workbook's trash instruction.
